title: Validate successful LTE Attach and Detach with a single UE under excellent radio conditions
description: Verify that a single UE can successfully perform LTE attach and detach procedures 10 consecutive times under excellent radio conditions as per 3GPP TS 23.401 specifications.
preconditions: Single cell scenario activated and unloaded, other cells powered off
Single UE (real or emulated) placed at cell center with LTE RSRP within excellent radio condition thresholds
End-to-end LTE setup operational with no connectivity issues
Test configuration parameters recorded
steps: Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach procedure
Wait for successful attach indication (attach complete message)
Verify UE is attached to correct cell (PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN)
Power OFF the UE to initiate UE-initiated detach procedure
Wait for successful detach indication (detach accept and signaling connection release)
Stop and save logs
Repeat the above steps 10 times
expectedResults: Attach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations
Detach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations
Attach latency (time from attach request to attach complete) recorded and within expected thresholds
Signaling message flows conform to 3GPP TS 23.401 clauses
Logs show correct cell attachment details
verificationMethods: Examine attach and detach signaling messages in logs
Check UE logs or application for cell identification parameters
Measure attach latency timing from logs
Confirm 10 consecutive successful attach/detach iterations

title: Validate successful 5G NSA Attach and Detach with Secondary Node Addition and Release for a single UE under excellent radio conditions

preconditions: Single cell scenario activated and unloaded, other cells powered off

End-to-end 5G NSA setup operational with no connectivity issues
Test configuration parameters recorded
steps: Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate 5G NSA attach procedure
Wait for successful attach indication and Secondary Node Addition completion (SgNB addition request and reconfiguration complete)
Verify UE is attached to correct LTE and NR cells (PCI, Global eNB ID, Global gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN)
Power OFF the UE to initiate UE-initiated detach procedure including Secondary Node Release
Wait for successful detach indication and Secondary Node Release confirmation (detach accept, UE context release, RRC connection release)
Stop and save logs
Repeat the above steps 10 times
expectedResults: Attach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations
Secondary Node Addition success rate is 100% over 10 iterations
Detach success rate including Secondary Node Release is 100% over 10 iterations
Signaling message flows conform to 3GPP TS 23.401 and TS 37.340 clauses
Logs show correct cell attachment details for LTE and NR cells
verificationMethods: Examine attach, Secondary Node Addition, detach, and Secondary Node Release signaling messages in logs
Check UE logs or application for LTE and NR cell identification parameters
Confirm 10 consecutive successful attach/detach and secondary node procedures
